T1-1.title: fixture failures lose descriptor ownership evidence
T1-1.repair: Test-owned raw descriptors are registered before os.open (fixture_open: OSError not_acquired, otherwise acquisition_uncertain) and closed at most once via fixture_close; run_filter/scripted_filter register the capture file before creation, close it at most once while fixture-owned, retain it UNKNOWN after an ambiguous reader start and record the reader's single close.
independent_test_oracles: t_fixture_fd_handoff_ownership: fifo_writer close/close-failure, run_filter capture closed once / ambiguous retained
T1-1.residual_or_conditional: Python-managed 'with open' fixture file creations elsewhere are unchanged (not raw descriptors).

T1-2.title: admission pins miss mutable native observation functions
T1-2.repair: Pins add native_members (os.waitid/waitpid/read/close/fstat/getpid, signal.getsignal, time.monotonic/time/sleep, select.select, Popen.__init__/_execute_child, LIBPROC functions), more functions (bsd_identity, task_rss, list_pids, _pidinfo, descendants, parse_pid_buffer, deadline_check) and constructor/method pins (Owned._owned_init/remember_identity/known_pids/_identity_uncertain, Helper.__init__); the refusal oracle mutates eight members independently.
T1-2.residual_or_conditional: Pins are identity checks in-process only.

T1-3.title: initial receipt publication lacks failure disposition
T1-3.repair: publish_json_x is a raw exclusive publication retaining an attempt record (creation/write/fsync/close states; simultaneous operation and close errors); main guards the receipt publication: failure prints the retained attempt evidence and returns 71 (never resolution proof); result/completion failures print evidence too; the receipt digest is carried into result.json.
independent_test_oracles: t_receipt_publication_failure_disposition (isolated main: 71, evidence printed, no runner load)
T1-3.residual_or_conditional: Parent must treat 71 as unresolved publication evidence.

T1-4.title: isolation oracle does not prove isolation of existing resource objects
T1-4.repair: Pre-existing inert sentinels (R.STATE entry and R.HELPER_LOG member) must have disjoint proxy counterparts; only counterparts are mutated; originals verified by canonical snapshots; registries compared with explicit structural snapshots (no repr); sentinels removed by identity.
T1-4.residual_or_conditional: Sentinels are test-only inert objects; production resources untouched.

T1-5.title: persistent-identity oracle omits nested-only identity boundary
T1-5.repair: Oracle exercises the real remember_identity with nested-only and conflicting outer/nested observations and a pid-less observation (refused); production retains valid nested identities and both conflicting keys with explicit uncertainty.
